# DSH row fixture

`dsh-market-row.html` is a static React render of the MIT-licensed official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plugin-market@0.2.1-rc.2` EntryCard with public CloudBase catalog data. It supplies the native DOM structure for the enhancement browser tests. Primitive class bindings and the style host are isolated test fixtures, as described in `docs/market-display.md`.

Official `lib/client.js` SHA-256: `e961988dd984dc527b0bfeed37f6ae45b4a72392a2eb21676350359d8a127a60`.
